init_distributed_mode: init distributed training mode from environment variables and set up NCCL backend for multi-GPU
save_model: save a model checkpoint with optimizer state, epoch, and AMP scaler to output directory
load_model: load a model checkpoint from local path or URL and restore optimizer and epoch state
MetricLogger_log_every: log training metrics at fixed intervals with ETA, iteration time, and GPU memory usage
merge_vmae_to_avmae: merge a video MAE checkpoint into an audio-visual MAE checkpoint by adapting positional embeddings and patch weights
